name: orderup-kenya
description: Multi-tenant SaaS Progressive Web Application for restaurants, hotels, bars, and venues in Kenya

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "server,customer,staff,admin" --prefix-colors "blue,green,magenta,cyan" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/server" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/customer-pwa" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/staff-portal" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/admin-portal"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/server
scripts.build:all: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=packages/ui && npm run build --workspace=apps/server && npm run build --workspace=apps/client && npm run build --workspace=apps/customer-pwa && npm run build --workspace=apps/staff-portal && npm run build --workspace=apps/admin-portal
scripts.build:server: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/server
scripts.build:client: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/client
scripts.type-check: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run type-check --workspaces --if-present
scripts.start: npx prisma db push --schema=apps/server/prisma/schema.prisma --accept-data-loss && node apps/server/dist/server.js
